title: broadcast.json
description: The fixed overlay state contract for the UNI Production Platform. The producer writes this file atomically (tmp + os.replace) to /var/lib/uni/broadcast/broadcast.json; nginx aliases it to /overlays/state.json with Cache-Control: no-store; every transparent 2D-canvas/CSS overlay page polls it with fetch(...,{cache:'no-store'}). DESIGN/REFERENCE only - not deployed. Field shape matches docs/UNI_PRODUCTION_PLATFORM.md exactly.

updatedUtc.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant this snapshot was written. Every page renders staleness honestly from this; if it is missing or old the page shows a muted STALE marker rather than faking liveness.

onAir.description: ON-AIR indicator state. When absent or value=false, the onair overlay shows nothing (never a fake LIVE).

value.description: True when the public program is live.

lowerThird.description: Animated lower-third (name strap). Crossfades in/out on the 'visible' flag.

title.description: Full-screen title / bumper card. Crossfades in/out on the 'visible' flag.

ticker.description: Ordered ticker items rendered as one seamless doubled-string CSS scroll. Empty array = no ticker shown.

caption.description: Live caption / subtitle line plus optional translations. The caption overlay selects a language via ?lang= override or this 'lang'.

text.description: The current transcript line in the primary language.

translations.description: Optional map of language code -> translated line. The overlay shows the requested language from here if present.

zones.description: IANA time-zone identifiers rendered with Intl.DateTimeFormat + tabular-nums.

music.description: Music-bed state for on-screen audio indicators (informational; OBS does the actual mixing).

nowPlaying.description: What segment/clip is currently on the program.

layout.description: On-air guest layout hint (talking-head / panel / pip) written by the set_layout tool; the stage page reads it.

brand.description: Brand asset filenames (served from the overlays static root).

evidence.description: Appliance evidence taxonomy badge. Class A is never styled here (A = independently reproduced, asserted off-air only).

class.description: A=independently reproduced, B=observed-with-artifact, C=command-output, Sec=security-relevant-unproven, pending=not-yet-established.

tone.description: Maps to a CSS class (left-border colour). 'accent' is the neutral brand-accent default the pages + CSS use; unknown/absent renders muted, never a confident colour.
